name: web_url
signature: int web_url( const char *StepName, const char *url, <List of Attributes>, [EXTRARES, <List of Resource Attributes>,] LAST );
description: Performs an HTTP GET to load a web page (or resource) from the specified URL. Supports the HTTP, HTTPS, and FTP protocols and is used in both URL-based and HTML-based recording modes. StepName becomes the step label and the automatic transaction name.

args.name: URL
args.desc: The target address (HTTP, HTTPS, or FTP).

args.name: TargetFrame
args.desc: The name of the frame that contains the link or resource.

args.name: Resource
args.desc: 0 = not a resource, 1 = the URL is a resource.

args.name: RecContentType
args.desc: The Content-Type header value of the response at recording time (for example, text/html).

args.name: Referer
args.desc: The URL of the referring page.

args.name: Snapshot
args.desc: The name of the snapshot file (.inf) used for correlation.

args.name: Mode
args.desc: The recording level: HTML or HTTP.

args.name: FtpAscii
args.desc: "1" for ASCII-mode FTP transfer, "0" for binary.

args.name: UserAgent
args.desc: Identifies the executing component (for example, ActiveX).

example:
web_url("www.abc.com",
    "URL=http://www.abc.com/",
    "TargetFrame=",
    "TargetBrowser=ABC Technologies",
    "Resource=0",
    "RecContentType=text/html",
    "Snapshot=t1.inf",
    "Mode=HTML",
    LAST );

web_url("Games",
    "URL=ftp://joe:secret@mygames.com/games/archive/loderunner.exe",
    "FtpAscii=1",
    LAST );

name: web_link
signature: int web_link(const char *StepName, <List of Attributes>, [EXTRARES, <List of Resource Attributes>,] LAST);
description: Simulates a mouse click on a hyperlink specified by attributes, causing the browser to display a new page or frame. Recorded only in HTML-based recording mode and must be executed after a previous operation that provides context.

args.name: Text
args.desc: The exact text displayed on the hyperlink.

args.name: Frame
args.desc: The value of the name attribute of the FRAME element.

args.name: TargetFrame
args.desc: The frame to which the link navigates.

args.name: Ordinal
args.desc: The sequence number used to distinguish between similar links.

args.name: ResourceByteLimit
args.desc: The resource download size limit, in bytes.

example:
web_url("test.html",
    "URL=http://localhost/test.html",
    "Resource=0",
    "RecContentType=text/html",
    "Referer=",
    "Mode=HTML",
    LAST );

web_link("Test1",
    "Text=Test1",
    LAST );

name: web_image
signature: int web_image( const char *StepName, <List of Attributes>, [EXTRARES, <List of Resource Attributes>,] LAST );
description: Simulates a mouse click on an image element, including client-side and server-side image maps. Recorded only in HTML-based recording mode.

args.name: Alt
args.desc: The ALT attribute of the IMG element.

args.name: Src
args.desc: The SRC attribute or image file name (for example, button.gif).

args.name: Frame
args.desc: The name of the frame that contains the image.

args.name: Ordinal
args.desc: The sequence number used to resolve ambiguity.

args.name: MapName
args.desc: The name of the associated map (client-side image map).

args.name: AreaAlt
args.desc: The ALT attribute of the clicked area (client-side).

args.name: AreaOrdinal
args.desc: The sequence number of the clicked area (client-side).

args.name: XCoord
args.desc: The X coordinate of the click (server-side image map).

args.name: YCoord
args.desc: The Y coordinate of the click (server-side image map).

example:
web_image("dpt_house.gif",
    "Src=../gifs/dpt_house.gif",
    "MapName=dpt_house",
    "AreaOrdinal=4",
    LAST );

web_image("The Web Developer's Virtual Library",
    "Alt=The Web Developer's Virtual Library",
    "Ordinal=1",
    "XCoord=91",
    "YCoord=17",
    LAST );

name: web_image_check
signature: int web_image_check(const char *CheckName, <List of Attributes>, <"Alt=alt"|| "Src=src">, LAST);
description: Verifies that a specific image exists in an HTML page. Either Alt or Src (or both) must be specified; if both are given, the check passes only when both match on a single image element.

args.name: Alt
args.desc: The ALT text of the image to search for.

args.name: Src
args.desc: The SRC value of the image to search for.

args.name: Frame
args.desc: Limits the search scope when there are multiple frames.

args.name: expect
args.desc: The success condition: found (default) or notfound.

args.name: matchcase
args.desc: Sets case sensitivity.

args.name: repeat
args.desc: Continue searching after the first match (yes/no, default yes).

args.name: report
args.desc: Report display: success, failure, or always (default).

args.name: onfailure
args.desc: Set to abort to stop the script when the check fails.

name: web_submit_data
signature: int web_submit_data( const char *StepName_, const char *Action, <List of Attributes>, ITEMDATA, <List of data>, [ EXTRARES, <List of Resource Attributes>,] LAST );
description: Submits a form "unconditionally", that is, without form context, so it can issue GET or POST requests without requiring a preceding form page. Field data is specified after the ITEMDATA marker, each item terminated by ENDITEM.

args.name: Action
args.desc: The target URL for the form submission.

args.name: Method
args.desc: POST or GET (default POST).

args.name: EncType
args.desc: The encoding: application/x-www-form-urlencoded or multipart/form-data.

args.name: EncodeAtSign
args.desc: Yes/No: encodes the @ character to its ASCII representation.

args.name: TargetFrame
args.desc: The name of the frame that contains the link or resource.

args.name: Referer
args.desc: The URL of the referring page.

args.name: Mode
args.desc: The recording level: HTML or HTTP.

args.name: Name / Value
args.desc: The field name and value (inside ITEMDATA).

args.name: File / FilePath
args.desc: Marks the field as a file, and the path of the file to upload.

args.name: ContentType
args.desc: The MIME type for the file upload.

example:
web_submit_data("default.aspx",
    "Action=http://lazarus/flightnet/default.aspx",
    "Method=POST",
    "TargetFrame=",
    "RecContentType=text/html",
    "Referer=http://lazarus/flightnet/",
    "Snapshot=t7.inf",
    "Mode=HTML",
    ITEMDATA,
    "Name=grpType", "Value=radRoundtrip", ENDITEM,
    "Name=lstDepartingCity", "Value=DEN", ENDITEM,
    "Name=lstDestinationCity", "Value=LAX", ENDITEM,
    "Name=txtDepartureDate", "Value=8/19/2003", ENDITEM,
    "Name=txtReturnDate", "Value=8/19/2003", ENDITEM,
    "Name=btnAvailableFlights", "Value=Next >", ENDITEM,
    LAST );

name: web_submit_form
signature: int web_submit_form( const char *StepName, <List of Attributes>, <List of Hidden Fields>, ITEMDATA, <List of Data Fields>, [ EXTRARES, <List of Resource Attributes>,] LAST );
description: Submits an HTML form. Can be executed only after a previous operation (it requires page context) and is recorded in HTML-based recording mode. Form fields are specified after ITEMDATA, each terminated by ENDITEM.

args.name: StepName
args.desc: The form name in the graphical script; used as the transaction name.

args.name: Action
args.desc: The target URL, matching the ACTION attribute of the FORM element.

args.name: Frame
args.desc: The name of the frame in which the operation was recorded.

args.name: TargetFrame
args.desc: The frame to which the form is submitted.

args.name: Ordinal
args.desc: The sequence number, used when other attributes are not enough to identify the form uniquely.

args.name: ResourceByteLimit
args.desc: The resource size limit, in bytes.

args.name: UserAgent
args.desc: The browser identification string.

args.name: name / value
args.desc: The field name and value (inside ITEMDATA).

name: web_custom_request
signature: int web_custom_request(const char *RequestName, <List of Attributes>, [EXTRARES, <List of Resource Attributes>,] LAST);
description: Creates a custom HTTP request with any method and any body. Typically generated for requests that other web functions cannot handle, such as REST/JSON, SOAP, or PUT/DELETE.

args.name: URL
args.desc: The page location (HTTP, HTTPS, or FTP).

args.name: Method
args.desc: Any HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, and so on).

args.name: Body / BodyBinary / BodyUnicode
args.desc: The request body content in various formats.

args.name: BodyFilePath
args.desc: The path of the file used as the request body.

args.name: EncType
args.desc: The Content-Type header value of the request.

args.name: RecContentType
args.desc: The Content-Type header value of the response at recording time.

args.name: Resource
args.desc: 1 if the URL is a resource, 0 if not.

args.name: Referer
args.desc: The URL of the referring page.

args.name: TargetFrame
args.desc: The name of the frame that contains the link.

args.name: ResponseTime
args.desc: The name of the parameter in which to store the response time.

example:
web_custom_request("web_custom_request_1",
    "URL=http://web.kalimanjaro.aws.swinfra.net",
    "Method=GET",
    "TargetFrame=",
    "Resource=0",
    "Referer=",
    "Body=",
    "ResponseTime=kalimanjaroResponseTime",
    LAST);

name: web_rest
signature: int web_rest(const char *StepName, "_URL_=<URL>", "_Method_=<HTML method>", "_EncType_=<encoding type>","_Body_=<body of message>", "_Snapshot_=<snapshot file>", [[ITEMDATA [["Name=<name>", "Value|FileName=<value>", ENDITEM,]]]] [[HEADERS [["Name=<header name>", "Value=<value>", ENDHEADER,]]]] LAST);
description: Sends a REST API request with any HTTP method. This action function is not recorded automatically but can be added to the script manually. Key-value pairs can be specified through ITEMDATA and custom headers through HEADERS.

args.name: URL
args.desc: The REST resource endpoint.

args.name: Method
args.desc: The HTTP verb: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, HEAD, OPTIONS.

args.name: EncType
args.desc: The request encoding: multipart/form-data, application/x-www-form-urlencoded, or raw.

args.name: Body
args.desc: The request message body.

args.name: ResType
args.desc: The response type, for example JSON (as shown in the documentation example).

args.name: ITEMDATA
args.desc: Name/Value (or FileName) pairs for POST data or URL parameters.

args.name: HEADERS
args.desc: Custom HTTP headers (Name/Value pairs terminated by ENDHEADER).

example:
web_rest("get all customers info",
    "URL=http://myServer/customers?limit={limit}&offset={offset}",
    "Method=GET",
    LAST);

web_rest("update customer info",
    "URL=http://myServer/customers/{cust_id}",
    "Method=PUT",
    "ResType=JSON",
    "Body={ \"address\":\"yyyy\" }",
    LAST);

web_rest("delete customer",
    "URL=http://www.example.com/customers/{cust_id}",
    "Method=DELETE",
    LAST);

name: web_websocket_connect
description: Opens a WebSocket connection that can be used to send messages, using either the standard (ws://) or secure (wss://) protocol. Callbacks for the open, message, error, and close events can optionally be registered.

args.name: ID
args.desc: The unique connection identifier (generated automatically during recording).

args.name: URI
args.desc: The WebSocket endpoint (ws:// or wss://).

args.name: Origin
args.desc: The Origin header value (optional).

args.name: SecWebSocketKey
args.desc: The Sec-WebSocket-Key header (optional; added manually).

args.name: SecWebSocketProtocol
args.desc: The Sec-WebSocket-Protocol header (optional).

args.name: SecWebSocketExtensions
args.desc: The Sec-WebSocket-Extensions header (optional).

args.name: OnOpenCB
args.desc: The callback for the OnOpen event (optional).

args.name: OnMessageCB
args.desc: The callback for the OnMessage event (optional).

args.name: OnErrorCB
args.desc: The callback for the OnError event (optional).

args.name: OnCloseCB
args.desc: The callback for the OnClose event (optional).

name: web_websocket_send
description: Sends a message to the server over an established WebSocket connection. At least one of Buffer or Buffer/BIN must be specified; if the send fails, the onErrorCB callback is invoked.

args.name: ID
args.desc: The identifier of the target WebSocket connection.

args.name: Buffer
args.desc: The payload as a text string.

args.name: Buffer/BIN
args.desc: The payload in binary representation.

args.name: Buffer/File
args.desc: The path of a file (local or UNC) containing the message content.

args.name: IsBinary
args.desc: 1 for a binary message, 0 for text.

example:
web_websocket_send("ID=0", "Buffer=sample text message", "IsBinary=0", LAST);
web_websocket_send("ID=0", "Buffer/File={myfile}", "IsBinary=0", LAST);

name: web_websocket_close
signature: int web_websocket_close("ID=connection ID", ["Code=<4_digit_code>",] ["Reason=<reason for closure>",] LAST);
description: Closes the WebSocket connection to the server with the specified ID. The close code and reason are optional, and all arguments support standard parameterization.

args.name: ID
args.desc: The identifier of the connection to close (required).

args.name: Code
args.desc: The WebSocket close code, an integer from 1000 to 1011 (optional).

args.name: Reason
args.desc: The reason for closing, as a string (optional).

example: web_websocket_close("ID=0", "Code=1000", "Reason=OK", LAST);

name: web_concurrent_start
description: Marks the start of a concurrent group. Functions inside the group are not executed immediately; they are registered and then run together when web_concurrent_end is called. The degree of parallelism depends on the emulated browser.

args.name: ConcurrentGroupName
args.desc: The name of the concurrent group (optional).

args.name: NULL
args.desc: The argument list terminator.

name: web_concurrent_end
description: Marks the end of a concurrent group and triggers simultaneous execution of all functions registered between web_concurrent_start and web_concurrent_end. The number of parallel items depends on the emulated browser.

args.name: reserved
args.desc: Set to NULL; reserved for future use.

name: web_js_run
signature: int web_js_run("Code=<JS code>" | "File=<file_name>", ["Domain=domain",] ["ResultParam=parameter name",] ["ActionStep=No|Yes",] [SOURCES,["File=file_name" | "Code=code", ENDITEM,]+] LAST)
description: Runs the specified JavaScript code. The JavaScript context persists across subsequent web_js_run calls (functions and variables remain available). JavaScript must be enabled in the runtime settings; parameters are accessed through LR.getParam() and LR.setParam(), not standard parameterization.

args.name: Code
args.desc: The literal JavaScript code to run.

args.name: File
args.desc: The path of the JavaScript file (relative to the Vuser directory).

args.name: Domain
args.desc: The base URL used to resolve relative URLs in the code.

args.name: ResultParam
args.desc: The name of the parameter in which to store the JavaScript result.

args.name: ActionStep
args.desc: Yes/No: marks the step as an action function (default Yes).

args.name: SOURCES
args.desc: The dependency section, evaluated before the main code.

name: web_js_reset
description: Clears the Vuser's JavaScript engine context, discarding all stored variables and objects and reclaiming memory. Called automatically at the start of an iteration when "Simulate a new user on each iteration" is enabled; call it manually to prevent excessive memory usage.

name: web_sync
description: Pauses Vuser script execution until a specified parameter is created by concurrent activity (for example, polling or push). Returns immediately if the parameter already exists; returns LR_FAIL if the timeout expires before the parameter is created.

args.name: ParamCreated
args.desc: The name of the parameter to wait for.

args.name: RetryIntervalMs
args.desc: The delay between retries, in milliseconds (default 500).

args.name: RetryTimeoutMs
args.desc: The maximum wait duration, in milliseconds (default 30000).

name: web_stop_async
description: Stops an asynchronous conversation along with all active and pending tasks in its conversation chain (including redirects and authentication). Returns LR_PASS if the conversation was canceled or does not exist.

args.name: ID
args.desc: The conversation ID of the conversation to stop (can be parameterized, for example ID={idParam}).

example:
web_stop_async("ID=Push_0",
    LAST);

name: web_reg_async_attributes
description: Registers that the next action starts an asynchronous conversation if it contains a request that matches the specified URL pattern. The asynchronous pattern (Push, Poll, LongPoll) and callbacks can be specified.

args.name: ID
args.desc: The unique conversation identifier.

args.name: URL
args.desc: The target URL; use the /RE modifier for a regular expression and /IC for case-insensitive matching.

args.name: Pattern
args.desc: The asynchronous model: None, Push, Poll, or LongPoll.

args.name: PollIntervalMs
args.desc: The delay between polling cycles, in milliseconds.

args.name: XMLHttpRequest
args.desc: Treat as a JavaScript XMLHttpRequest (No/Async/Sync).

args.name: CrossStep
args.desc: Yes/No: the step may complete before the server response is complete.

args.name: RequestCB
args.desc: The callback for modifying the request URL/body.

args.name: ResponseHeadersCB
args.desc: The callback invoked when the response headers are received.

args.name: ResponseBodyBufferCB
args.desc: The callback for the response body buffer.

args.name: ResponseCB
args.desc: The callback invoked at the end of the conversation.

example:
web_reg_async_attributes("ID=Push_0",
    "Pattern=Push",
    "URL=http://push.myStream.com/myStream/STREAMING_IN_PROGRESS?LS_session=123456789ABCDE&LS_phase=2903&LS_domain=myStream.com&",
    "RequestCB=Push_0_RequestCB",
    "ResponseHeadersCB=Push_0_ResponseHeadersCB",
    "ResponseBodyBufferCB=Push_0_ResponseBodyBufferCB",
    "ResponseCB=Push_0_ResponseCB",
    LAST);

name: web_util_set_request_body
description: Sets a string as the body of the next request in an asynchronous conversation. Called from a Request Callback function; its argument supports standard parameterization.

args.name: aBodyStr
args.desc: The string to use as the new request body.

name: web_util_set_request_header
description: Sets a custom HTTP header, given a header name and value, for the next request in an asynchronous conversation. Called from a Request Callback; both arguments support standard parameterization.

args.name: Header
args.desc: The custom header name (for example, Accept, Accept-Encoding).

args.name: Content
args.desc: The header value.

name: web_util_set_request_url
description: Sets the URL for the next HTTP request in an asynchronous conversation. Accepts an absolute URL and encodes it automatically, so do not pass an already URL-encoded string. Called from a Request Callback.

args.name: aUrlStr
args.desc: The absolute URL string, for example http://www.site.com/bin/cgi.exe?a=b (do not encode it beforehand).
